title: Opposition protest announced in January for February 11
notes: S003 reports that Berisha announced a future mass protest on January 27 without a date; S012 search metadata reports the date was set on January 31 for February 11, and S017's AP metadata dates the rally to February 11. This is a planned and later out-of-month event, not a January assembly.

title: Roskovec teachers' transport reimbursement petition and conditional strike lead
notes: The opened report describes 174 affected teachers and a petition signed by 34, but no assembled group. A union representative conditionally warned of a future strike; employee and petition totals are not turnout.

title: Bilisht garment workers' reported protest against employer
notes: Search-only metadata on an item published January 5 alleges 149 workers protested an employer and union dispute. The exact body cache-missed; the event date, headcount, and any domestic-government or state-policy demand are unverified. Preserve as a provisional exclusion and revisit only if body or independent contemporary evidence becomes available.
